## Core Services & Primary Navigation
- [Home Page](https://homesalesfairfax.com/): Official portal featuring active Bright MLS property inventory, neighborhood market dossiers, and in-home consultation booking.
- [Hire Top Listing Agents (Sell Your Property)](https://homesalesfairfax.com/sell): Dedicated seller advisory covering micro-market pricing strategy, cinema-grade 4K HDR media and drone staging, corporate relocation buyer network, and aggressive contract defense.
- [Instant Home Valuation (CMA)](https://homesalesfairfax.com/home-valuation): Direct request for verified Bright MLS comparative market analysis prepared manually by Elena & Kirill.
- [Fairfax County Market Intel Report](https://homesalesfairfax.com/market-report): Real-time analysis of absorption velocity, average days on market (DOM), and list-to-sale ratios across ZIP codes 22030, 22031, 22032, and 22033.
- [325+ Verified Client Reviews](https://homesalesfairfax.com/testimonials): Complete directory of authentic seller and buyer testimonials, case studies, and negotiation outcomes.
- [About Elena Gorbounova](https://homesalesfairfax.com/about): Detailed biographical overview, legal acumen, negotiation philosophy, and dual-brokerage leadership.
- [Contact & Showing Tours](https://homesalesfairfax.com/contact): Direct contact channels to book private showings, property tours, or in-home seller walkthroughs.

## Regional Divisions (Northern Virginia)
- [Virginia Divisions Directory](https://homesalesfairfax.com/divisions): Index of all major jurisdictional divisions across Northern Virginia.
- [Fairfax County Division](https://homesalesfairfax.com/divisions/fairfax-county): High-demand school pyramids, county parks, Metro commuter hubs, and high-velocity housing markets.
- [City of Fairfax Division](https://homesalesfairfax.com/divisions/city-of-fairfax): Historic Old Town charm, 0% county tax district, GMU cultural corridor, and Vienna Metro accessibility.
- [Arlington County Division](https://homesalesfairfax.com/divisions/arlington-county): Orange/Silver Line Metro corridors, urban luxury townhomes, and proximity to Amazon HQ2 and the Pentagon.
- [City of Alexandria Division](https://homesalesfairfax.com/divisions/city-of-alexandria): Historic Old Town waterfront, Carlyle high-rises, and Seminary Hill enclaves.
- [Loudoun County Division](https://homesalesfairfax.com/divisions/loudoun-county): Ashburn tech corridor, Dulles Greenway transit, and expansive acreage estates.
- [Prince William County Division](https://homesalesfairfax.com/divisions/prince-william-county): Gainesville, Haymarket, and Lake Ridge waterfront communities.

## Featured Subdivisions
- [Subdivisions Directory](https://homesalesfairfax.com/subdivisions): Index of all high-turnover neighborhoods and HOA communities.
- [Mantua (ZIP 22031)](https://homesalesfairfax.com/subdivisions/mantua): Wooded half-acre to full-acre lots within the Woodson High School pyramid.
- [Mosby Woods (ZIP 22030)](https://homesalesfairfax.com/subdivisions/mosby-woods): Classic mid-century colonials and split-levels walking distance to Vienna Metro.
- [Franklin Farm (ZIP 22033)](https://homesalesfairfax.com/subdivisions/franklin-farm): Master-planned community with 6 fishing ponds, 13 miles of trails, and Oakton/Chantilly pyramids.
- [Kings Park West (ZIP 22032)](https://homesalesfairfax.com/subdivisions/kings-park-west): Lake Royal lakeside recreation and Robinson Secondary IB pyramid.
- [Burke Centre & Lake Braddock (ZIP 22015)](https://homesalesfairfax.com/subdivisions/burke-centre): Conservancy amenities, pools, tennis, and direct VRE commuter rail to Washington DC.
- [Oakton Estates (ZIP 22124)](https://homesalesfairfax.com/subdivisions/oakton-estates): Prestigious multi-acre luxury enclaves minutes from Tysons Corner and Dulles Toll Road.
